fields.name: Positive Compel
fields.desc: An aspect makes the situation harder for you. Gain 1 Fate Point.
fields.mechanic: offer compels, accept or pay 1 FP to refuse

fields.name: Negative Compel
fields.desc: An aspect causes problems. You can refuse by paying 1 Fate Point.
fields.mechanic: GM or player offers, target decides

fields.name: Tag-Back
fields.desc: After a compel is accepted, the compel becomes an aspect on you.
fields.mechanic: compel then accept then aspect until end of scene
